name: Jezero Crater - western crater floor to delta front

crs.name: Equirectangular Mars 2000 Sphere IAU
crs.longitude_convention: east-positive; native CRS central meridian 0, domain -180..180 (values here 77.3-77.5 E)
crs.local_frame: x_m = easting - origin_easting; y_m = northing - origin_northing_bottom. Projected metres. East-west ground distance = projected distance * cos(latitude).

habitat.name: Hypothetical habitat (placed at Octavia E. Butler landing localization)
habitat.note: No habitat exists on Mars. Placed at the rover's first localized position after landing (site 3, drive 0, sol 13) so the origin sits at a well-documented, flat crater-floor location.

units.name: Upper etched unit
units.note: Upper etched unit: widely occurring olivine-rich unit with several surface textures.

units.name: Jezero fan 2 unit
units.note: Jezero fan unit 2: topographically higher, younger member of the Jezero fan (delta) deposits.

units.name: Eolian bedform unit
units.note: Eolian bedform unit: young windblown bedforms (for example transverse aeolian ridges).

units.name: Lower etched unit
units.note: Lower etched unit: olivine-rich unit found only inside Jezero crater, the stratigraphically lower complement of the upper etched unit.

units.name: Jezero floor unit
units.note: Jezero floor unit: crater-floor unit interpreted by the map authors to underlie the fan units; published age estimates range widely (see pamphlet).

disclaimer: Static historical orbital data. 20 m DEM cannot resolve rocks or human-scale hazards. Research prototype: not certified for EVA navigation or life support.

map_contract.crs_definition: Local metric frame of the study-area crop: x_m = projected easting - west-edge easting, y_m = projected northing - south-edge northing, in the source Equirectangular projection on the Mars 2000 sphere (R = 3396190 m, lat_ts = 0, lon_0 = 0).

context.note: Whole Mars 2020 TRN CTX orthomosaic, block-averaged for display. Routing uses only the planning area.

global_basemap.title: Viking MDIM 2.1 colour mosaic, 232 m/px (NASA Mars Trek)
